components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; font-family: var(--font-source-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), scale 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand); color: var(--brand-ink); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hover); }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The neutral button; what a Button with no variant renders.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--line); } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface-2), var(--ink) 6%); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action: crit outline, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: var(--crit); border-color: var(--crit); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--crit-soft); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Full-pill status label; the tone's text colour on its soft background, always with its word.
components.html: Sample data Brand Valid Awaiting Suspect
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-source-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-neutral { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-chip-brand { background: var(--brand-soft); color: var(--brand-text); } .ds-chip-ok { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); } .ds-chip-warn { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); } .ds-chip-crit { background: var(--crit-soft); color: var(--crit); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat surface with a 1px line edge and a 13px corner.
components.html:
Panel title

Surface background, line border, 13px radius.

Panel heading

Panel body text in ink on surface.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line); font-family: var(--font-source-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: var(--font-bricolage), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-panel-desc { color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-label-caps { font-family: var(--font-plex-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Label, input and hint; focus is an ink border and ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-source-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink); } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 600; } .ds-field-hint { color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-input { height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; caret-color: var(--brand-text); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--crit); }

narrative.overview: Dealwright ("Dealwright by Authority Solutions") is a sales workspace that takes a lead from web form to signed deal. The design system gives every screen one set of colours, type, shapes and base components, in a light and a dark theme of equal standing. The look is a quiet, warm working surface: warm off-white and warm grey neutrals, one red for the brand, three status colours, and a monospaced label face for panel headings. The palette is provisional until open question 12 is answered.
keyCharacteristics: Two themes, light and dark, switched by one class on <html>; every colour is a token with a value in each.
Warm neutrals, one red, three status colours, each status with a soft background partner.
Three type families with fixed jobs: headings, body and controls, labels.
Compact controls, 9px control corners, 13px panel corners, full-pill chips.
Flat surfaces with line borders; shadow is nearly absent.
Screens use tokens and components only. No screen contains a raw colour value.

rules.name: The Fill-Only Brand Rule
rules.body: brand is a fill, never a text colour. On the dark ground it reaches only 2.9 to 1. Red text and links use brand-text.

rules.name: The Ink-2 Floor Rule
rules.body: Muted and secondary text, placeholders and labels use ink-2. Do not set text in ink-3.

rules.name: The Word Beside Colour Rule
rules.body: A status colour never carries meaning alone. A chip always contains its word.

rules.name: The No Raw Colour Rule
rules.body: Screens and components name tokens. A hex value appears only in the two theme blocks of globals.css.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Headings and names are Bricolage Grotesque. Everything read or pressed is Source Sans 3. IBM Plex Mono is for small labels only.

rules.name: The Loaded Weights Rule
rules.body: Use only loaded weights: 600 and 700 for headings, 400 and 600 for body, 400 and 500 for the label font.

rules.name: The Label Is A Heading Rule
rules.body: label-caps names a panel or a section. It is not a decorative line above a larger headline.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: A panel is surface, a 1px line edge and a 13px corner. Do not add a shadow to make it stand out.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: A Button with no variant is the neutral button. The main action must ask for variant primary, and a screen has one.

rules.name: The Height-Only Logo Rule
rules.body: Screens never place as-logo.png themselves. They use Wordmark or AuthoritySolutionsLogo, pass a height, and never a width.

dos: Do name a token for every colour: bg-surface, text-ink-2, border-line.
Do use brand-text for links and any red text, in both themes.
Do ask for variant primary on the one main action; leave other buttons on the default.
Do pass a tone to every chip and put the status word inside it.
Do place the endorsement through Wordmark endorsed and size the logo by height.
donts: Don't write a hex or other raw colour outside the two theme blocks in globals.css.
Don't set text in brand or primary. On the dark ground it is 2.9 to 1.
Don't set text in ink-3. On the light ground it is 3.5 to 1.
Don't let colour carry a status alone.
Don't add a shadow to a panel.
Don't show the logo on a dark surface without the plate.
